scenarios.name: placed with Pages: the start page is built at once — Current Page Home, one child, its Page Inputs handed no parameters; Did Mount
placed at #/about: the URL's page, not the start page
placed at #/product/7?x: the parameter from the path, and one from the hash's own query stays in the segment
placed at ?tab=x#/product/a%2Fb: the query joins the path's parameters; an encoded slash is part of the parameter
path mode, /product/a%25b?tab=x: the path, the % decoded once
path mode at /: the empty path matches Home ('/')
hash setting 'hash' reads the hash as unset does
Url path shop, path mode at /shop/about: the prefix is part of every pattern
Url path '' puts an empty part in front: '/about' no longer matches
Url path /shop/ trims to shop
Url path null is no Url path: the router shows its page and answers its Reset (row C116, fixed in P109 ISL-048)
a URL with no page: the start page, with the query
no Pages: nothing shown; a Reset fails router/no-pages
Pages with no start page and no match: a Reset fails router/no-start-page
a start page the index has no page for: router/page-not-found
start page Twice (two Page nodes): built, deleted, router/component-is-not-a-page; Current Page Component goes (never sent)
routes name pages; a start page outside them is still shown
routes without the URL's page: the URL is not matched, the start page shown
a malformed query is kept as written: the router shows its start page (row C115, fixed in P109 ISL-048)
a malformed path segment is kept as written and matches nothing
Reset on the page it shows with the same parameters: Unchanged
two Resets in one frame: one reset, both answered alike
Reset before the mount's reset lands: answered by the frame's reset
UNNAMED: placed with no Name at #/about — the project's index names an unnamed Router Main, so the URL's page shows, and Back to #/product/3 shows Product (P109-S18)
UNNAMED: placed with Name '' — the same: '' is Main on both sides
UNNAMED: placed with no Name, Name written Main — the index already names it Main, so #/about still matches
UNNAMED: placed with no Name, Name written Side — the index is the saved project (Main), the lookup is Side, so no URL matches and the start page shows

UNNAMED at #/product/7: the mount's Reset builds Product; Url path written shop and a Reset in the same frame wait behind the build and fail when it lands (the start page Twice is not a page) — Product stays on, so a second Reset fails the same way and builds nothing
navigate Product 7: handed at the frame's end, on 1 ms later — built, Page Inputs handed {id:7}, #/product/7 pushed, Done
navigate 'a/b c': the parameter encoded into the path
navigate with a parameter not in the path: a query before the hash
navigate Product without its id: {id} stays in the URL, and a reset reads it as the id
path mode navigate: a path, the query after
navigate with Url path shop: the prefix in the URL
navigate with Url path null: the page is built and shown, its URL pushed, Done (row C116, fixed in P109 ISL-048)
navigate Twice: a navigate builds a component whatever its Page nodes
navigate with no target: Failure navigate/no-target-page
navigate to a component with no page: Failure navigate/page-not-found
navigate in a new tab: window.open, Done; the page stays
navigate in a new tab, path mode
navigate to the page it shows: Unchanged

navigate Product 7 twice: the second Unchanged; a Reset reads '7' from the URL, a change — Done, handed to the page the navigate built (row C117, fixed in P109 ISL-048); a third navigate with 7 rebuilds
navigate to a Router named Other while only Main is registered: the one router takes it
a navigate waits its 1 ms: nothing before the clock moves
two navigates in one frame: both built in turn at the same millisecond
an Unchanged then a build in one frame
a Failure then a build in one frame
a new tab then a build in one frame
a build then a navigate back to the same page in one frame
navigates a frame apart, at different times
a Reset and a navigate in one frame: the reset first, the navigate a millisecond later
a navigate and a Reset in one frame
a navigate lands, then a Reset reads the URL it pushed: Unchanged
Back to #/product/9: popstate — a reset at the frame's end
Back to #/: Home again
after a navigate built Product 1, Back to #/product/2: the reset takes it as the page it shows with new parameters, and its Page Inputs are handed id 2 (row C117, fixed in P109 ISL-048)
Back to a malformed query: the reset keeps it as written and answers (row C115, fixed in P109 ISL-048); a later Back moves on
Back to #/twice: built and refused as no page
Back while unmounted: no one listens
Back twice in one frame: one reset
Back and a Reset in one frame: one reset, the Reset answered
Back, path mode
placed named Other: the index names it Other; a navigate still reaches it
Name written Other while on the page: registered again — a reset; the index still names it as placed, so the URL matches no page
Name written to what it was: a reset all the same
Name written twice in a frame, then Back: the second reset waits for the first's microtask
unmounted: a navigate queued under its name; mounted, a Main one replays, and a blank one too — a blank name is Main (row C118, fixed in P109 ISL-048)
unmounted with a queued Main navigate to the page the start would show: replayed, no reset
unmounted, a queued navigate under Other replays when the Name becomes Other
Pages written while on the page: a reset at the frame's end
Pages written while off the page: stored only
Mounted off: Will Unmount; a Reset still rebuilds (the Reset has no mount guard)
Mounted off and on: registered again — a reset onto the page it shows
placed off the page, then on: the first reset at that frame — Children Count a frame late
placed at #/product/1, Back to #/product/2: the page a reset built is handed id 2 (Done); a Reset after it Unchanged
placed without Pages, off the page: a Reset in the frame it mounts fails, the mount's reset after it; a later Reset answered
no Pages: a failing Reset in the frame it is unmounted; mounted again, a later Reset answered
no Pages: unmounted, then a failing Reset in the same frame; mounted again, a later Reset answered
at #/product/1, Back to #/product/2 and a Reset in one frame: Done, handed id 2; a Reset after it Unchanged
at #/product/1, Back to #/product/2 and a Name write (the name it was placed with) in one frame: the Name's reset hands id 2 at once; the frame's reset Unchanged
at #/product/1, unmounted, Back to #/product/2 (no one listens), mounted again: the mount's reset hands id 2
off the page and on again, with a Reset in that frame: Unchanged, the mount's reset after it; a later Reset answered
off the page and on again, a Reset before the Mounted write in that frame: the same
Pages written before the first frame: the placing's reset read the placed Pages — About lands, then the written start page Twice is refused; Current Page Component stays About on the wire
